responsibility: Implements the NetBSD-specific Rust frontend target hook initializer by defining TARGET_RUST_OS_INFO. It reports Rust target metadata for NetBSD targets—unix family, netbsd OS, unknown vendor, and empty environment—via rust_add_target_info and exports that behavior through the targetrustm hook object. This file is only the Rust frontend OS-identification layer for NetBSD, separate from NetBSD’s general target specs and builtin patching support.
